name: John Smedley
why: Fine-gauge knitwear in merino and Sea Island cotton, made in the same Derbyshire mill since 1784.
origin: Founded at Lea Mills, Derbyshire, in 1784.

onething.n: verified — direct product page. The house's own Sea Island cotton, knitted at 30 gauge on the Derbyshire site, with a three-button placket and a fashioned stand collar; the house lists Adrian in its Icons collection. Sea Island confirmed in person at the London store. The sibling Isis carries the same cloth and dates to the 1930s

notes.wool: 30-gauge merino on the same Derbyshire site since 1784
notes.whitet: sells a tee as a basic (price pass); not read for more — seeded 27 Sep 2026, provisional

cities: No store of its own in the US · department stores and independent menswear shops, and its own site

marks: none (only Sea Island Cotton - a named/protected fibre appellation rather than a performance technology)
